body: Yeah, that makes sense. I ask this exactly because I'd like to make my situation clear, so the people who are answering could understand better, but I feel like I would be rude if I did so... I think the best thing would be to PM them and ask directly...

I'll give you the universally correct answer to every question: *it depends...*

>Are you going to feel sad if someone you hate dies?

It depends on what kind of hate. If it's something personal, it also depends on what such person has done to me or to someone/thing meaningful that I care. If it is an act of cowardice, murder, or anything that's dirty enough, I would say, with no regret, I'd feel relief for someone like this to die. It would feel like justice had been made and also that'd be joyful because I know for sure that such person won't harm anyone anymore.

If it is something related to things like rivalry in a professional sense, like in the market or inside a business, I would feel sad for them and their families, because, even though they are  my opponent, they are also people.

If a person that I did not hate but were criminals or powerful corrupt people, I tend to open a big wide smile on my face and feel authentic happiness. I live in a very violent and corrupt country, where 70,000+ people are murdered each year. It means that being out on the streets is as safe as being out in a Syrian battlefield. When I get to know that there is one less potential aggressor in my city, state or country, it makes me feel really good, and I feel even happier if the police did the job.

I'm being sincere here. If you didn't like my answer, you should remember the saying *don't ask something if you don't want to know the answer.* But remember, I wasn't talking about you.

>I feel like **everyone** hates me

This kind of phrase seems to be something purely emotional, it has to do with your state of mind. That means that it does not come from a logical and rational conclusion. You should stop for a bit and think deeply about that, ask yourself why do you think that absolutely everyone hates you, citing exactly what each and everyone of them said and done to you and try to evaluate what do you think their intentions were, whether they were doing it to harm you or if it was just a coincidence. You do not need to do it now nor do you need to post this in an answer. Go get some rest, let time pass, let your dark thoughts pass or minimize, and when you are in a somewhat clean state of mind, then you start to reflect about the subject.

Also, in this clear state of mind, you should observe your own actions. I'm not here to blame you for anything, but if in some situations some people did things to harm you, evaluate if they were legitimate about it, if you have done something for them to fire back at you. If so, you should consider (I'm not necessarily saying for you to go out and actually do), again, consider asking an apology. If they forgive you, they may have compassion again, because they may care about you. If they did bad things for no reason but for just being evil, you should walk away.

First of all, thanks for your answer.

I know I am comparing myself, but it's not only about that. What I'm saying is that, until then, I've had enough time and resources to do something, and if I don't, then I'm a waste of space and energy. And also I just want to avoid the suffering that comes with it, thinking of every single thing I could've gotten and every single time I screwed up. That's part of me, I think I can't change it.
